    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    idx = 0
    T = int(input[idx])
    idx += 1
    results = []
    for _ in range(T):
        N = int(input[idx])
        idx += 1
        A = list(map(int, input[idx:idx + N]))
        idx += N
        B = list(map(int, input[idx:idx + N]))
        idx +=N
        target_positions = defaultdict(list)
        for i, b in enumerate(B):
            target_positions[b].append(i)
        points = 0
        used_positions = set()
        for i, a in enumerate(A):
            if i in used_positions:
                continue
            cycle = []
            current = i
            while current not in used_positions:
                cycle.append(current)
                used_positions.add(current)
                next_pos = target_positions[a][0]
                target_positions[a].pop(0)
                a = B[next_pos]
                current = next_pos
            cycle_length = len(cycle)
            for j in range(cycle_length):
                points += A[cycle[j]] - A[cycle[(j + 1) % cycle_length]]
        results.append(points)
    print('\n'.join(map(str, results)))
